scope: Candidate 1.2.0 supports schema-element(Name), schema-attribute(Name) and document-node(schema-element(Name)) in item-type aliases and supported structural sequence types. Schema declaration names retain their declaration namespace under prefix rebinding and must resolve to imported global elements/attributes; unknown or unavailable declarations raise XPST0008 and undeclared prefixes raise XPST0081. Wildcards, unions and empty declaration names raise XPST0003. Schema-element under ##any uses no namespace for an unprefixed declaration; unprefixed schema attributes always use no namespace. Document shorthand such as document-node(root|other) normalizes to document-node(element(root|other)), including wildcard and EQName alternatives, and reuses single-root matching. Direct host type operands and alias-free XSLT document/schema bindings normalize the new forms. Twenty-nine new regressions cover node identity, namespace mismatches, imported declarations, substitution members, typed attribute matching, rejection of untyped nodes, nested arrays, ##any defaults, empty documents and static validation of unused bindings. Annotated function types, package exposure and broader native type-alias gaps remain follow-ups. N04/N05 and REQ-126 remain In Progress. Published version stays 1.1.3; candidate 1.2.0 remains unpublished.
